pages.text: Build a closed 5x5x5 box with Terminal Shell, place the terminal, controller and security block on walls, and put 1 Core in the middle.$(br)The terminal auto-binds a nearby formed Serializer as network storage.

Register an Identity Card in the security page, then right-click ports with the same card to bind them.$(br)Dimensional bridge enables cross-dimension, chunk loaders keep the network alive, loss suppressors reduce transfer loss.
